Two Killed in Light Aircraft Crash Onto German House

A light aircraft crashed onto the roof of a house in Ganderkesee, Germany, resulting in the deaths of two men. The victims were aged sixty-five and seventy-seven. Emergency services conducted a recovery operation, and residents of the affected home were evacuated.
